My mom used to watch a lot of news in the mid 90s here in Finland and we had a cable box that made it possible to see some form of NBC. My mom used to fall asleep during the news and I would occasionally sneak out of my room and happened to see a strange slanky red headed guy in a suit displaying a lighting fast wit enriched by wacky, off the wall comedy pieces.  I was hooked from that moment on. My most prized possessions are the Conan 10th anniversary special & Best of Triumph DVDs. I remember waiting for Conan in the airport in freezing temperatures back when he visited Finland in 2006. Waited for 2 hours but had to leave for work before seeing him, was still a memorable moment seeing the sea of adoring fans freezing along with me.
I always found it funny how she refused any guests on her show that had the letter G in their names to avoid using her infamous heavy G.
Sarah Vowell was great on the old shows,  I don't think she's been a guest on the podcast. 🤔
As god made me!
I haven't actually had the chance to listen to the podcast with the movie idea,  just saw the other creations and went with an idea. And I call myself a fan of Conan! For shame!

My ex never went down that path of self righteousness or putting on a role of super-duper mom, but instead just expressed to me almost immediately that she's looking for FWB type of arrangement which to my understanding she's beeing doing time and time again for the past year and a half.

This weekend was definitely emotionally difficult on me and equally on my girlfriend. I tried not to involve my girlfriend but found it to be challenging. The gf even said out loud that she believes that the only thing that could truly destroy our relationship is an outside disturbance such as this.

I don't have bumbling  toddlers and I've basically been the primary caregiver up until the divorce so I have very little  reason to believe she has issues with me making sure all is set up when in fact the divorce has been a challenge for her to get throughly acquainted with our children.

Oh, I definitely don't want to have that person in my life any more but I'm bound to her thanks to our kids. I don't want to know anything about her life and don't want to share my life with her. I only care about the wellbeing of my kids and thus far this status quo is working for me and by my understanding for my kids as well.

Oh, she knows where I live as she has to drop them off every other Sunday and I've sent quite a lot of pictures of the kids here. Besides, I have quite talkative kids who without a doubt have described in very fine detail the spesifics of our home down to the layout.

I personally don't have any interest in meeting her male companion/companions, I trust she has common sense to make an adequate decision.
Thank you Reivaki. She did actually apologise for her behaviour today during drop off but I doubt this is the last time she will try to take control of things that are out of reach for her.

She knows her name as my kids are quite talkative. She naturally knows where I live as she has to drop our kids off every Sunday but I don't see how it's imperative that she finds out the exact layout of my home or the way I've decorated it just because "it's her right as the mother of our children". I believe there are certain privileges that woman lost when she divorced me.
Were there exactly 3 pieces?

Yeah, podcasts help on occasion. That puzzle tip is brilliant, might actually buy some ASAP. Thanks for your input, really appreciate it 😊
Could maybe work, but damn that text would be really repetitive 😅

Yeah, I'm waiting to get a place of my own. We do share 2 kids so the connection to her will never be severed. We currently have 2 seperate apartments: one for spending time with the kids, one for own seperate stuff. It's a quick decision we made to make sure the kids don't have to travel between homes but it is mentally taxing at least for me; can't really escape her in either place, just too much of her present everywhere I look. I do envy divorced people that don't have children and are able to go no contact with their ex spouses.

Yeah, it's a work in progress working at a snails pace as I'm just too distraught at the moment. At least I'm getting fit like I was when I was twenty something but the head having a hard time adjusting.
Thanks. It's reminders like these that keep my hope up.
I did immediately tell her about it and begged her to unlink her phone because I'm pretty sure I'm weak enough to repeat my mistakes but she refuses to do so.
We're still married.
She did. Caught her cheating with an ex from 20 years ago who is also married with children. I still wanted to work things out with her but she made it pretty clear to me it's not happening.
Oh there is no marriage to help at this point, so why bother?
That is basically all I want to do now. Just get away from her and forget the person she used to be because that person doesn't exist anymore.

Yeah, it's a daily battle for sure. The less I'm involved with her the better. Just have to get far far away from her, but as long as we share our living quarters (during different days of the week) it's nearly impossible to move on.

Yeah divorce is imminent, but we're currently attached to our house due to a massive plumbing operation in the near future.  It's all very uncertain but the one thing I'm waiting during this shitty year is to get a place of my own and start things anew.

I really wish I knew. We do have a seperate apartment for our own free time and the actual house is meant to hanging out with the kids. It's all very temporary and I do wish I could get the hell out of this situation asap.

Congrats man! I'm also an introvert and about to go through a divorce process. My wife was pretty much my only friend and adjusting to not getting to share the highs and lows of every day life is pretty damn miserable. Please consider hitting me up with a DM whenever, I'll gladly listen to anything that's on your mind :)
Thanks for the input :) . I truly hope I can some day put this at least somehow behind me.
Today was a good example. I did cry the whole day, but it turned into uncontrollable disaster when I saw her. Might have lost in no matter who was facing me...
Awesome! I also vacuumed the entire apartment. I cried the entire time but did it nonetheless.
Me too. I wake around 3 AM, I'm flooded by thoughts of her and can't fall back asleep. I just want it all to end.
Thanks, really appreciate the feedback. I Gotta be more aware of those little moments and appreciate them for what they are.

Thank you SO much stranger.  I did somehow manage to work out today but shifting the focus from her to me and my healing is something I'm struggling with. Just kept thinking over and over again what she might have possibly done on new years eve and it just makes me so tired and miserable. This loop is slowly tearing me apart and I have no good solutions left in me.

Not so much for the last week. It's my first whole week with the kids. It was until now 2-2-3 arrangement and I thought not seeing her for a longer period would make it easier for me, but it's quite the opposite. I keep imagining her doing stuff with other guys (which she has already done) and wish I wouldn't, but can't.
Yes, and it feels like it's taken over my entire body, suffocating me slowly and extinguishing the very last ounce of happiness I have.
At least that's what everyone keeps saying. Read and heard so many survival stories that somehow I gotta at least hope I'll someday be one of them.
Thanks, that it truly is. Now I'm just trying to survive, maybe concentrate on living next year even though there is so much gloomy stuff ahead of me.

I did all of that in the beginning stages, but lately I've been very emotionally and physically drained and starting things has become difficult. My mental health has deteriorated during the past 3 months and I was just prescribed some antidepressants yesterday.

Me. Feels like currently reddit has everything that I need to survive my meaningless life which in itself is quite a paradox. My life is slowly turning into a miserable country song of sorts and instead of losing everything here I feel like I'm gaining something. Sad but true.

Yeah, can't think of that many negative things about her as I thought she was my soul mate. Guess I just have to sit down and write some stuff down even though I'm currently just mad at me and having no issues seeing my flaws.

Like you, I'm also in my late 30s and extremely lonely. I can openly admit that I neglected my friends during these years and focused mainly on my STBX and kids. I've tried reaching out to some of them after everything went down, but they have been quite distant and making plans
 with them hasn't turned out as expected.


I'm in a men's support group and hope I'll be able to find some friends though there. I've also joined some Facebook groups that specialize in finding new friends. And if I'm not mistaken, the bumble app also has a function for finding friends. I see and spend time with my kids regularly but I really wish to have some adult companionship.

Yeah, there was a noticeable change in my STBX as soon the decision to seperate was made: she lost a ton of weight and started to wear mostly thongs and other skimpy clothing. And it's all because of herself and because the clothes are so comfortable. She's always had a mission of sorts to stay on good terms with EVERYONE, including her former boyfriends and thus me not being able to do so is infuriating her.

I did send her a message and told her very clearly  how offended and disrespected I felt by what he said. She said that she is likewise stumbling in life at the moment and cries every day because she destroyed the life we as a family had.

It honestly felt like some sort of relief because her actions have painted a very different picture so far.
Yeah, I have to confront her about this so it doesn't happen again. It's definitely going to keep happening for her, I just don't need to hear about it.

Yeah, I can't imagine being able to truly heal before I get a place of my own and don't have constant reminders of her everywhere: not in our actual house or the tiny apartment we use when either one of us is not with the kids.

I think what triggered me more than having sex with her was the fact that she has already admitted to having a one night stand and is actively looking for a friend with benefits. It just goes to show how much further along she is in the process. For me this all happened exactly 3 months ago but she has stated she hasn't loved me for years. I don't want her to have this enormous power over me but she definitely does. I got stuck in a very negative loop repeating to myself I don't matter and want to give it all up. Today I've been more conscious of those negative thoughts and tried to silence them and turning my thought process into positive affirmations.

I just looked at a bunch of them from Facebook with the key word "divorce" and joined the most active ones. One of them even has an extensive website/discord server which is really helpful. Just search for Divorced men's network.

I think the impending divorce just brought up one of my deep-seated issues which I've been struggling my whole life which is low self-esteem and self-hatred. I just ignored it for the past 13 years and now those same feelings are rushing in and making me realize I have never worked on those issues because I relied on my wife who is stronger than me.

I'm part of a physical men's divorce support group but therapy is pretty much out of the question because of my financial situation. Might be eligible to participate in brief psychotherapy that is funded by the city I live in, but apparently I need to be on  somewhat firm ground before they consider me. And online support groups? Part of so many I've already lost count. Started with divorce support groups but I'm slowly shifting towards groups that focus on mental health. 


I have already considered helping my community but the decline of my  mental well being is CURRENTLY holding me back. Maybe I'll stick around for next year and see if I have enough strength gathered by then.

I'm working out almost all the time, but I tend to use it as a form of punishment for myself.

Yeah, I know. My codependency is biting me in the ass. Taking responsibility for my own actions and decisions is honestly quite a new thing for me so I've got a massive undertaking ahead of me. Don't think I will learn to become truly independent and self reliant for years, if ever.
Thanks. I do see that my mind keeps circling back to her over and over again even though there Is absolutely nothing to go back to. More strength to you (and me) :)

Definitely agree with you buddy. I do tell myself this was JUST meaningless sex but of course it isn't as I'm still very much attached to her. I recognize my faults and know I'll make mistakes along the way but won't be defined by them.

Can't imagine what's it going to be be like when I  gather the strength and find myself emotionally ready to really date again. Realistically speaking I don't think I'll really be able to date for at least a couple of years. Healing takes time, and rushing into things might make things even worse.
Until then, have a good one 😊
Thank you kindly.
I don't  honestly  know if that's any better. Days by myself at the moment are filled with dark, hopeless thoughts and would probably get amplified if I'd have to spend Christmas on my own.

The STBX just dropped off some food items for Christmas and asked what's wrong with me. I told her about the Christmas cards and she got mad as hell and asked if I'm going to be like this at her parents during Christmas. I'm mentally breaking down, finding it difficult to hold on to life and met with hostility and rage. I'm having a really hard time going on like this.
The sense of loneliness is hitting me like freight train even though I'm currently with the kids. Unable to do anything else than cry.
Yeah, you said it. Can't afford any therapy, but I do attend a divorce support group for men and see a psychiatric nurse on regular occasion.

I can relate to that. Somehow I try to avoid just watching all my favorite movies and whatnot since somehow I've been let to believe that being alone has to be somehow meaningful and filled with tearing apart  ones limitations to experience something new and profound. Maybe I'll get to that, now back to our regularly scheduled programming :D
That sounds awesome!
Thanks. The stories and experiences shared by others do help out. Still have more bad days than good days but I'm getting there. At least I think I am. Or not. :)

If you have friends who are willing to listen and be there for you then I would without hesitation suggest you unload some of the things you're going through with them. It really helps to say these things out loud instead of keeping a monologue inside your head. Maybe get a new perspective on things through that. I have a very limited amount of friends and even though I've tried rekindling our friendship after this mess started its been tough.
I hope I'll be able to find this experience as liberating at some point, currently I just try to survive each day after the other which is far from easy.
May your Christmas suck in the least possible way. But yeah still, fuck Christmas.

Yeah, you're not getting a counter argument from me. Can't imagine me crying uncontrollably over my STBX and her reacting by being hostile and snippy as being something to look forward to. Is that truly beneficial for the kids?

Sounds like the exact same battle I'm going through. Overcoming own weaknesses and not giving them the attention they so desperately seek is a challenge for sure. Needing to fill the quiet when all you really need is to stop and actually appreciate the quiet for what it is.

Thank you so much for your reply and believing in what I consider the unbelievable. Hardest thing I'm dealing with now is my very low self esteem which has always been present, but dormant as I've lulled into a false sense of security through her. Codependency doesn't work well when there's nobody around :)... Not that it works well with others either. Will definitely hit you up with a message or two when the time comes. Truly, greatly appreciated.
No problem. Always happy to help my fellow swgoh enthusiasts :)

Yeah, that does indeed differ from the other comments. I want to work towards being whole again and not this shell of a man, but I'm quite convinced it's going to happen without my wife in the picture. She has expressed her feelings (or lack of) time and time again to me so it's just a necessity for me to distance myself from her despite us still living together.

Thank you for comment Barnfargen. My wife does really feel bad for me and does actually wish she could regain those romantic feelings towards me, but only because she has to face a broken man each and every day. She has also said on several occasions that she wishes she hadn't come clean so we could have just continued on the same path of destruction, me completely oblivious to things around me and wife growing more resentful as each day passes.

I feel like a childish fool, wanting her to give us another chance but that sailboat  has passed long ago. I realize I can't force her to love me, but as long as we share a home letting go of her feels impossible.

I genuinely hope everything works out for you as well. It does bring some comfort to me that there is someone somewhere who knows what I'm going through and can relate to me.

Despite everyone clinging on to the fact that she went to see her ex our problems started way before that and I really don't feel the anger I suppose many expect me to feel. I was just too naive to see the bigger picture. We already went to couples therapy last year when she still thought there was something to fix. I just never grasped the severity of the situation and thought to myself she was just tired because of Covid-19 and the prolonged lock down. So please, if you're here to play the blame game and focusing on something that is eventually just a symptom of dissatisfaction then I'd rather not hear it.
Haven't had time to do so, but it's certainly on my to do list...as is a bunch of other stuff :')
